label: PF Backlog 485
title: EPIC: Feature<->Epic<->children model + generated-product backlog + full field data
body:
## Problem / why
The feature bridge is flat (Feature<->single item, unused) and generated products get no epics/children; most backlog fields carry no data.

## Goal & value
Features from the requirements/architect phase map to Epics (containers) whose children are the work items; the generation pipeline builds that model for products; every item carries the full field set with data.
